title: Batch and group report rows
summary: Split report rows into fixed-size batches, group rows with exactly one key call per item, and sum numeric slices using generics.
objectives: Write generic slice helpers bounded by type parameters.
Validate batch sizes and preserve input order inside batches and groups.
Sum int, int64, and float64 values through a single numeric constraint.
constraints: Keep the ErrInvalidBatchSize sentinel, Number constraint, and all three function signatures.
Batch rejects a size below 1 with ErrInvalidBatchSize and a nil result.
Return a non-nil empty slice or map for empty input.
GroupBy must call the key function exactly once per item.
Batch and GroupBy must preserve the input order inside each batch or group.
Sum accepts int, int64, and float64 through the ~ constraint and returns the zero value for empty input.

examples.explanation: Full batches come first and the final batch may be shorter.
Each group keeps the original input order and key runs once per item.
The numeric constraint covers floating-point values as well as integers.
